                const otherAnswer = otherItem.querySelector(".mt-4.text-gray-600");
                const otherIcon = otherItem.querySelector(
                  ".ri-subtract-line, .ri-add-line",

                  otherIcon.classList.remove("ri-subtract-line");
                  otherIcon.classList.add("ri-add-line");
                }
              });
              answer.classList.toggle("hidden");
              if (isOpen) {
                icon.classList.remove("ri-subtract-line");
                icon.classList.add("ri-add-line");
              } else {
                icon.classList.remove("ri-add-line");
                icon.classList.add("ri-subtract-line");

            });
          });

        const initAudioPlayer = () => {
          const songThumbnails = document.querySelectorAll(
            ".w-16.h-16.relative.group",
          );
          if (!songThumbnails.length) return;
          let currentlyPlaying = null;
          songThumbnails.forEach((thumbnail) => {
            thumbnail.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
              e.preventDefault();
              const audio = this.querySelector("audio");
              const playIcon = this.querySelector(".ri-play-fill");
              if (!audio || !playIcon) return;
              if (currentlyPlaying && currentlyPlaying !== audio) {
                currentlyPlaying.pause();
                const prevIcon =
                  currentlyPlaying.parentElement.querySelector(".ri-play-fill");
                if (prevIcon) {
                  prevIcon.classList.remove("ri-pause-fill");
                  prevIcon.classList.add("ri-play-fill");
                }
              }
              try {
                if (audio.paused) {
                  audio.play().catch(() => {});
                  playIcon.classList.remove("ri-play-fill");
                  playIcon.classList.add("ri-pause-fill");
                  currentlyPlaying = audio;
                } else {
                  audio.pause();
                  playIcon.classList.remove("ri-pause-fill");
                  playIcon.classList.add("ri-play-fill");
                  currentlyPlaying = null;
                }
              } catch (err) {
                console.warn("Audio playback error:", err);
              }
            });
          });
        };
        const initGenerationOptions = () => {
          const generationOptions = document.querySelectorAll(".generation-option");
          if (!generationOptions.length) return;
          generationOptions.forEach((option) => {
            option.addEventListener("click", function () {
              generationOptions.forEach((btn) => btn.classList.remove("selected"));

            });
          });
        };
        const initStyleTags = () => {
          const styleInput = document.querySelector(
            'input[placeholder="Enter style tags"]',
          );
          const styleTags = document.querySelectorAll(
            ".flex.flex-wrap.gap-2.mb-3 button",
          );
          if (!styleInput || !styleTags.length) return;
          styleTags.forEach((tag) => {
            tag.addEventListener("click", function () {
              const currentValue = styleInput.value.trim();
              const tagText = this.textContent;
              if (!tagText) return;
              if (currentValue === "") {
                styleInput.value = tagText;
              } else if (!currentValue.includes(tagText)) {
                styleInput.value = `${currentValue}, ${tagText}`;
              }
            });
          });
        };
        const initSwitchToggles = () => {
          const switchLabels = document.querySelectorAll(
            "label.relative.inline-block",
          );
          if (!switchLabels.length) return;
          switchLabels.forEach((label) => {
            const input = label.querySelector("input");
            if (!input) return;
            const updateSwitchState = () => {
              if (input.checked) {
                label.classList.add("switch-active");
              } else {
                label.classList.remove("switch-active");
              }
            };
            input.addEventListener("change", updateSwitchState);
            updateSwitchState();
          });
        };
        initFAQAccordion();
        initAudioPlayer();
        initGenerationOptions();
        initStyleTags();
        initSwitchToggles();
      });
